notes.text: The digital Tanchuma parallel opens with Rabbi Acha the great and the verse about grass withering. The Yelammedenu edition label remains Heilprin’s.

The exact baraita behind this independent classification remains open. The Tanchuma attests the Acha epithet but gives no explicit classification. The similarly named speaker in the Zevachim/Menachot baraita lacks the epithet.
